definition.F_to_GT_original_RMS_L: free_to_R12_RMS_bbox_pct / 100; original predicted-area points, distinct direction
definition.GT_angle_abs_gap: Descriptive abs(predicted small-angle fraction - same GT fraction), not a mesh-quality certificate
definition.GT_angle_reference: same gt_free complement, original shape_quality formula; all corner angles and per-face minima
definition.GT_to_F_original_RMS_L: R12_to_free_RMS_bbox_pct / 100; original frozen seed9911 target points
definition.coverage_fraction: mean(d(q,F)<=0.01*L) on the same frozen coverage_points
definition.fixed_query_MSE: mean((d(q,F)/L)^2) inherited field; A20 alpha=1 has L=L0
definition.original_surface_RMS: historical area-sampled prediction and separate frozen pairwise_target_points; %L
definition.post_scale: fit dot(C1.x,Calpha.x)/dot(C1.x,C1.x) about original origin; only C and own F1
definition.primary: A validation ratio=.2 alpha=1; two noises within each of 8 parents, then parents equal
definition.reference_contract: No-response/Post-scale use before_C+own_before_output+edited_C; not current-C-only inference
definition.slope_error: abs(b-1) computed per curve BEFORE any averaging
definition.strict_validation_columns: 4 parents x 2 noises x 3 target columns =24; 12 per noise; not independent parents
definition.width: equal triangle-corner X q95-q05, numpy quantile linear
